remarks: Enjoy Stamford Mid-City at its best in our Two Bedroom, Two Full Bath unit at The Classic. Entry Hall leads to Dining Area, and generous sized Living Room that opens to a private 1,400 Square Foot terrace designed for great entertaining. Fully equipped Kitchen with fruit-wood cabinetry, Gas Range with Oven, Microwave, Refrigerator, Dishwasher, Marble Counters, Breakfast Bar and Pantry. The Primary Suite is full of light from a wall of windows w/Walk-in-Closet plus Linen Closet, Primary Bathroom with Double Sinks, Commode, Shower over Tub; Second Bedroom w/Closet. Full Second Bathroom with glass enclosed Shower. Full Sized/In Unit Washer & Dryer. Two Indoor Garage Spaces. Bldg. includes Roof top Club Room w/Fireplace, Kitchen, Great Views-perfect for Special Events; Health/Club Fitness Center, Indoor Pool, Outdoor sun deck, Dog Walking Park, 24 Hour Concierge. Located just steps from fabulous eateries, Library, Movie Theater, Park and the Town Mall. Five Minutes from Stamford Railroad Station and I-95. When they say..."You can have it all"--it means you are living at The Classic. Excellent Credit--a Must, absolutely no pets.
